title: Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) and Robotic System Components
description: This course explores the integration of sensors, indicators, controllers, and final control elements for Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) and robotic systems. Closed loop control theory, Process/Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID), loop tuning, and control loop troubleshooting are also covered. Students will also learn process control system design and Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) tuning.
outcomes: Measure inputs and outputs, identify logic states during operation, and troubleshoot a PLC-controlled system.
Measure, evaluate, and optimize the open- and closed-loop response of a PID control system.
objectives: Describe the functions and operations of a closed-loop control system at the block level.
Select sensors, controllers, and actuators appropriate for a given task.
Program a PLC controller to execute a sequential task.
Tune a PID control loop for optimized operation.
Develop and execute a troubleshooting plan for process control systems.
content: Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) loop tuning for closed loop system
Process systems, e.g. water and wastewater and oil refinery
Interface between PLC and Human Machine Interface (HMI)
Create and understand electrical plans for advanced process systems
lab: Program a Controller with Sensor integration
Build and test communication protocol between PLC and Human Machine Interface (HMI)
assignments: Students are expected to work on homework in order to learn the materials
Example: Develop and execute a PLC program that includes a PID loop
Students use the concepts and technical skills learned in the class to analyze and solve practical problems.
Example: Troubleshoot a given PID motor speed control circuit.
Example: Accessible Logic: Using PLCs to Bridge Equity Gaps
Students demonstrate their understanding of the materials with tuning PID constants for a loop control device.

Example: Describe the interaction between a temperature sensor and a heater in a closed-loop temperature control system. Describe interaction between a pump control and pressure sensor used in water pumping system.
